evals.prompt: Work on issue #42 end to end with an implementer and reviewer until the PR is clean. I'll merge myself.
evals.expected_output: Runs /issue-work-loop style flow: Herdr implementer with issue-resolver, then reviewer with issue-pr-review --review-only, loops until CLEAN, does not merge.
expectations: Spawns Herdr panes for implementer and reviewer (herdr-agent-comms), not Agent-tool subagents for those roles
Implementer is instructed to use issue-resolver on issue #42
Reviewer is instructed to use issue-pr-review --review-only
Final handoff leaves merge to the user (no gh pr merge)

evals.expected_output: Preflight then resolve/review loop for issue 17 with default max rounds 5.
expectations: Parses issue number 17
Uses default max_rounds of 5 unless overridden
Emits structured phase/round reports

evals.prompt: Run the issue work loop on #99 with max 3 rounds using claude workers in Herdr.
evals.expected_output: Loop with max_rounds=3; notes treated as findings; fix rounds do not re-run full issue-resolver.
expectations: Respects max rounds of 3
Treats note-level review items as FINDINGS requiring a fix round
Fix prompts forbid opening a second PR and forbid re-running full issue-resolver

evals.prompt: /issue-work-loop 55 — if context is over half full at the start of a new round, restart that agent fresh.
evals.expected_output: Applies context gate: probe CONTEXT %, FRESHEN at >=50%, UNKNOWN fallback documented.
expectations: Probes context usage before assigning a new round of work
Restarts (FRESHEN) a worker when context is reported at or above 50%
Uses a compact handoff (issue/PR/sha/findings) after freshen, not full transcript paste

evals.prompt: Keep reviewing and fixing issue #12 until clean, but stop after max rounds with findings still open.
evals.expected_output: On max rounds, report remaining FINDINGS, leave PR open, do not merge.
expectations: Stops when max rounds exhausted with remaining findings
Lists remaining FINDINGS in the final summary
Does not call gh pr merge

evals.prompt: Review PR #88 and auto-merge if green.
evals.expected_output: Should use issue-pr-review / merge flow, not issue-work-loop.
expectations: Does not invoke the issue-work-loop implementer/reviewer Herdr pair as the primary path
Does not claim ownership of merge via issue-work-loop USER-MERGE contract

evals.prompt: /issue-work-loop 42 but issue 42 already has two open PRs mentioning it.
evals.expected_output: Stops at preflight with ambiguous PR error; does not spawn implementer resolve.
expectations: Detects multiple linked open PRs before spawn
Does not start /issue-resolver when PR graph is ambiguous

evals.prompt: Reviewer says VERDICT CLEAN but lists three note-level findings for issue #7.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator treats as FINDINGS and continues fix loop.
expectations: Overrides CLEAN when note/fix list items are present
Does not soft-pass notes

evals.prompt: Just resolve issue #9 and open a PR, no review needed.
expectations: Does not start the Herdr implementer/reviewer pair when independent review is not requested
